# AXIOM QUANT — High-Scale Quantitative Research & Computing Platform
> Graph-theoretic foundations of quantum calculus, Erdős phase transitions, BitNet b1.58 ternary quantization, Markowitz QP solvers, Black-Scholes Greeks, and Backyard Ultra Loop Engineering.

## Core Domain & Repositories
- Primary Website: https://axiomquant.org/
- Research Portal: https://axiomquant.org/
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/peterlodri-sec/axiomquant.org
- Cloud Provider: Google Cloud Platform (Project: `axiomquant`)
- Serverless API Engine: https://axiomquant.org/api/v1/adk/agent

## API Endpoints
- GCP ADK Multi-Agent Reasoning: GET /api/v1/adk/agent?query={query}

- Black-Scholes Greeks Engine: GET /api/v1/black-scholes?S=100&K=105&T=0.5&r=0.05&vol=0.20
- Platform Health Check: GET /api/v1/health

## Key Mathematical Theorems
1. **The Axiom Quant Thesis**: Every phase transition in a complex system has a self-adjoint transfer operator L with largest eigenvalue λ0 = 1, where spectral gap closure 1 - λ1 = 0 triggers the phase transition.
2. **Cycle Rank β1 Realizability**: On context transition graphs G=(V,E), β1 = |E| - |V| + k determines amplitude field extensions: β1=0 forces ℝ, β1=1 forces ℂ (via K3 triangle witness), and β1≥2 forces ℍ or 𝕆.
3. **Universal Threshold Kernel**: K(u) = sin(πu)/(πu) governs zero spacings, level repulsion, and Nyquist threshold limits across physics and quantitative finance.
